mechanism: Sumatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with haloperidol (D2 antagonist) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and extrapyramidal side effects through opposing neurochemical effects on serotonergic and dopaminergic pathways.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for signs of serotonin syndrome (agitation, rigidity, hyperthermia) and extrapyramidal symptoms, and consider alternative antipsychotic with lower serotonergic interaction potential.
